records.jp: 2分間金魚すくい競争……
records.en_original: The two-minute goldfish scooping competition begins...
records.en_auxiliary: The two-minute goldfish scooping competition begins...
records.en: The two-minute goldfish scooping competition begins...

records.jp: よーい、スタート！！
records.en_original: Ready... GO!
records.en_auxiliary: Ready... GO!
records.en: Ready... GO!

records.jp: また負けたー！！　なんで勝てないのー！？
records.en_original: Gah, I lost again?! Why can't I beat you?!
records.en_auxiliary: Gah, I lost again?! Why can't I beat you?!
records.en: Gah, I lost again?! Why can't I beat you?!

records.jp: いやー大量大量。今日は調子がいいね
records.en_original: Whew, what a haul! I am on a roll today!
records.en_auxiliary: Whew, what a haul! I am on a roll today!
records.en: Whew, what a haul! I am on a roll today!

records.jp: ぐにゅにゅ……。<CR>同じ道具なのになんでここまで差が出るの！
records.en_original: Grrr... We're using the same scoop, how can this be happening?
records.en_auxiliary: Grrr... We're using the same scoop, how can this be happening?
records.en: Grrr... We're using<CR>the same scoop, how can this be happening?

records.jp: こういうのにはコツがあるんだよ、コツが
records.en_original: There's a trick to it, my dear Yuki.
records.en_auxiliary: There's a trick to it, my dear Yuki.
records.en: There's a trick to it, my dear Yuki.

records.jp: お、教えて先生！
records.en_original: Master, I beg of you... Teach me your ways!
records.en_auxiliary: Master, I beg of you... Teach me your ways!
records.en: Master, I beg of you... Teach me your ways!

records.jp: よかろう……
records.en_original: Very well...
records.en_auxiliary: Very well...
records.en: Very well...

records.jp: 愛央老師！
records.en_original: Thank you, Master Ao!
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Master Ao!
records.en: Master Ao!

records.jp: 私に任せなさい。<CR>キミを一日で金魚すくいマスターにしてあげよう
records.en_original: I will train you, young one. Before the day's end, you too shall become a master goldfish scooper.
records.en_auxiliary: I will train you, young one. Before the day's end, you too shall become a master goldfish scooper.
records.en: I will train you, young one.<CR>Before the day's end, you too shall become a master goldfish scooper.

records.jp: どうしようかな～
records.en_original: I am not sure you are ready...
records.en_auxiliary: I am not sure you are ready...
records.en: I am not sure you are ready...

records.jp: そこを何とか！　おねが～い！
records.en_original: Please! I'll do anything!
records.en_auxiliary: Please! I'll do anything!
records.en: Please! I'll do anything!

records.jp: 仕方ないなぁ～。じゃあ私の秘技、<CR>伝授しちゃおうかな
records.en_original: If you insist... I shall pass on my secret technique.
records.en_auxiliary: If you insist... I shall pass on my secret technique.
records.en: If you insist... I shall pass on my<CR>secret technique.

records.jp: まず、ポイの使い方だけど――
records.en_original: First up, your tool: the scoop.
records.en_auxiliary: First up, your tool: the scoop.
records.en: First, about how to use the poi—

records.jp: ってな感じで、<CR>斜めにスライドさせるイメージでやるのがコツかな
records.en_original: You see? You must scoop at an angle. Therein lies the trick.
records.en_auxiliary: You see? You must scoop at an angle. Therein lies the trick.
records.en: That is the idea.<CR>The trick is to imagine sliding it diagonally.

records.jp: ほえー……愛央って物知りなんだね
records.en_original: Whoa... You're so wise, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa... You're so wise, Ao.
records.en: Whoa... You're so wise, Ao.

records.jp: 昔ちょっとテレビで見たことがあるだけだよ。<CR>これくらい、物知りのうちに入らないって
records.en_original: Actually, I saw it on TV years ago. Not sure you can call that wise...
records.en_auxiliary: Actually, I saw it on TV years ago. Not sure you can call that wise...
records.en: Actually, I saw it on TV years ago.<CR>Not sure you can call that wise...

records.jp: でも、よくそんなちょっとしたこと覚えてたね？
records.en_original: The fact that you still remember that makes you wise in my book!
records.en_auxiliary: The fact that you still remember that makes you wise in my book!
records.en: The fact that you still remember that makes you wise in my book!

records.jp: え～、そうかな～？
records.en_original: Hehe, you think so?
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, you think so?
records.en: Hehe, you think so?

records.jp: そうだよ。あたしはこんなこと全然知らなかったもん
records.en_original: Well, yeah. I had no clue, after all.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, yeah. I had no clue, after all.
records.en: Well, yeah. I had no clue, after all.

records.jp: ……褒めても何も出ないよ？
records.en_original: I'm not giving you a reward for all your compliments, you know.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not giving you a reward for all your compliments, you know.
records.en: I'm not giving you a reward for all your compliments, you know.

records.jp: 何も求めてないって！<CR>純粋に、愛央はすごいなーって思っただけ！
records.en_original: I wasn't expecting one! I was just telling you my honest thoughts about how amazing you are!
records.en_auxiliary: I wasn't expecting one! I was just telling you my honest thoughts about how amazing you are!
records.en: I wasn't expecting one! I was<CR>just telling you my honest thoughts about how amazing you are!

records.jp: そ、そう。ふーん……
records.en_original: O-oh, I see...
records.en_auxiliary: O-oh, I see...
records.en: O-oh, I see...

records.jp: じゃ、今のコツ実践してみるね。<CR>見てて、愛央
records.en_original: All right, time to try out your secret technique. Watch me, Master Ao!
records.en_auxiliary: All right, time to try out your secret technique. Watch me, Master Ao!
records.en: All right, time to try out your secret technique.<CR>Watch me, Master Ao!

records.jp: オッケー……
records.en_original: Okay!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay!
records.en: Okay!

records.jp: （いつになく真剣な表情……）
records.en_original: (She looks uncharacteristically serious...)
records.en_auxiliary: (She looks uncharacteristically serious...)
records.en: (She looks uncharacteristically serious...)

records.jp: ふーーーーっ……
records.en_original: *Fwoooohh*
records.en_auxiliary: *Fwoooohh*
records.en: *Fwoooohh*

records.jp: ふにゃあああああああああ！？
records.en_original: Waaaaaggghh?!
records.en_auxiliary: Waaaaaggghh?!
records.en: Waaaaaggghh?!

records.jp: な、な、ななななにすんの！？
records.en_original: Wh-wh-what are you doing?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-wh-what are you doing?!
records.en: Wh-wh-what are you doing?!

records.jp: え？　なんか、真剣な表情だったから
records.en_original: I just thought you looked super serious.
records.en_auxiliary: I just thought you looked super serious.
records.en: Huh? You had such a serious expression, so...

records.jp: 理由になってなくない！？
records.en_original: That's not a reason!
records.en_auxiliary: That's not a reason!
records.en: That's not a reason!

records.jp: 可愛い反応が見れたから私は満足
records.en_original: Hehe, well you made a cute squeal, so I'm happy.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, well you made a cute squeal, so I'm happy.
records.en: Hehe, well you made a cute squeal, so I'm happy.

records.jp: あたしが満足じゃないの！<CR>もー、今度絶対仕返しするから……
records.en_original: Well, I'm not! I'll get you back, Ao...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I'm not! I'll get you back, Ao...
records.en: Well, I'm not!<CR>I'll get you back, Ao...

records.jp: （……なでなで）
records.en_original: (Pat, pat, pat the Yuki...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Pat, pat, pat the Yuki...)
records.en: (Pat, pat, pat the Yuki...)

records.jp: えっ、な、何……？
records.en_original: What...is...this...?
records.en_auxiliary: What...is...this...?
records.en: What...is...this...?

records.jp: いや、なんだか妹ができたみたいで<CR>可愛かったから、つい
records.en_original: I suddenly felt like you were my cute little sister, and it made me want to pat you on the head!
records.en_auxiliary: I suddenly felt like you were my cute little sister, and it made me want to pat you on the head!
records.en: It felt as though I had gotten a younger sister,<CR>and you were so cute that I did it without thinking.

records.jp: ちっこいって言いたいのか！？
records.en_original: Hey, are you saying I'm small?!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, are you saying I'm small?!
records.en: Hey, are you saying I'm small?!

records.jp: えー、違うよ？
records.en_original: Huh? No!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? No!
records.en: Huh? No!

records.jp: いーや、あたしには分かるぞ！<CR>子供っぽいってバカにしてるんだ……！
records.en_original: Don't lie, I know you were! I hate it when people treat me like a little kid!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't lie, I know you were! I hate it when people treat me like a little kid!
records.en: Don't lie, I know you were! I hate<CR>it when people treat me like a little kid!

records.jp: もう、そんなこと言ってないじゃ～ん！<CR>そんな拗ねないでよ！
records.en_original: No, I didn't mean it like that! Don't take it the wrong way!
records.en_auxiliary: No, I didn't mean it like that! Don't take it the wrong way!
records.en: No, I didn't mean it like that! Don't<CR>take it the wrong way!

records.jp: ぶー……
records.en_original: Hmph!
records.en_auxiliary: Hmph!
records.en: Hmph!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
